ScenarioControl.description: One control stage of a typed scenario.

ScenarioPoint.description: One observation of a typed scenario before its cutoff (SI value of the observed quantity).

ScenarioValue.description: A condition value of a typed scenario: a number in SI or a text (e.g. a fuel name).

WspSchema.description: Wire tag of model specs, patches, build manifests and forecast requests.

description:
Conditions (and, where the release reads them, controls and an early prefix) typed by a person
for a served release. The host admits it as a synthetic prefix (`evidence_class = synthetic`,
never a NASA run) and returns its `input_hash` for `ForecastInput::Prefix`. There is no agent
tool for it: a forecast never runs on a prefix a language model assembled from text.

cutoff_s.description: Seconds since the release's time origin up to which the scenario is known.

observations.description: Observations of the release's observed quantity at or before `cutoff_s`.

phase_established_at_s.description:
Seconds since the time origin at which the modelled phase was established (burning
droplet, ignited fabric), when the release reads it.

test_date.description: Test date `YYYY-MM-DD`, for releases whose laws depend on the era of the test.

title: ScenarioRequest
